exam.title: Databricks Certified Associate Developer for Apache Spark
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; the official guide recommends related training and six months of hands-on Apache Spark experience. Practice Python/SQL, driver/executor and job/stage/task execution, schemas and I/O, DataFrame operations, joins/aggregates/UDFs, partitions/shuffles/AQE/UI/log diagnosis, Structured Streaming recovery/state, Spark Connect and Pandas API on Spark.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Developing Apache Spark™ DataFrame/DataSet API Applications
Troubleshooting and Tuning Apache Spark DataFrame API Applications
Using Spark Connect to deploy applications
Using Pandas API on Apache Spark

review.notes: The October 30, 2025 detailed live-version PDF and current seven-domain weighted page were reconciled. The guide explicitly distinguishes the active 45-question, 90-minute, Python-focused, no-test-aid exam from the retired Spark 3.0 Python/Scala credential and stale commercial metadata. Three scenarios, eight labs and 39 original checks cover driver/executor/resources, session/structured APIs, application-job-stage-task execution, partitions/shuffles/cache/GC/fault tolerance; schema-aware file/JDBC SQL I/O, modes/tables/views; column/null/dedup/aggregate/date/join/union/I/O/UDF/shared-variable operations; repartition/coalesce/skew/AQE/UI/log diagnosis; streaming output/state/watermark/checkpoint/recovery; Connect versus deployment modes; and Pandas API/Pandas UDF boundaries. All 11 guide URLs are cataloged: 7 reachable and Databricks Community, two O'Reilly books and Udemy automation-blocked; none missing or broken. Vendor sample questions are linked rather than reproduced, and the broken Spark 4.2 pandas documentation route discovered during review was replaced with its current canonical path.

findings.title: JDBC partition bounds were not distinguished from filtering
findings.evidence: Official bounds define stride and query cannot combine with partitionColumn.

findings.title: Watermark guidance implied too broad a state bound
findings.evidence: Classic dedup state depends on keys; within-watermark ID dedup is time-bounded.
findings.recommendation: Distinguish three operator/key contracts, timestamp-varying copies and permanent business uniqueness.
findings.resolution: Distinguish three operator/key contracts, timestamp-varying copies and permanent business uniqueness.

findings.title: Stateful streaming scenario prescribed AQE too broadly
findings.evidence: Upstream 4.1 migration support is specifically stateless streaming.
findings.recommendation: Correct stateful scenario and explain engine/version boundary.
findings.resolution: Correct stateful scenario and explain engine/version boundary.

findings.title: Older cast expectations need an explicit runtime boundary
findings.evidence: ANSI mode is enabled by default since Spark 4.0.
findings.recommendation: Add tolerant parsing/quarantine guidance with version and configuration evidence.
findings.resolution: Add tolerant parsing/quarantine guidance with version and configuration evidence.

findings.title: DataFrame objectives lacked concrete adversarial fixtures
findings.evidence: Null filtering, nondeterministic dedup, joins and position-based union need observable expectations.
findings.recommendation: Add original fixture, four decision cases and twelve answers; report actual execution limits.
findings.resolution: Add original fixture, four decision cases and twelve answers; report actual execution limits.
